scenarios.name: 3-1 Network Partition Resilience
scenarios.description: When 1 validator is partitioned, remaining 3 validators (75% power) maintain BFT consensus without interruption.

scenarios.name: 2-2 Network Partition Safety Halt (Zero Fork Guarantee)
scenarios.description: When network splits evenly (50%-50%), neither partition reaches >2/3 quorum; consensus halts safely with zero forks.

scenarios.name: Variable WAN Latency & Asynchrony Resilience
scenarios.description: Consensus engine timers tolerate cross-cloud WAN round-trip latency and jitter up to 500ms without false timeout cascades.

scenarios.name: Message Drop, Duplication & Out-of-Order Delivery
scenarios.description: P2P network stack handles dropped, duplicated, and out-of-order consensus packets idempotently without panics.

scenarios.name: Interrupted Commit & Crash Recovery
scenarios.description: Storage engine enforces atomic batch execution for block data and AppHash commitment; partial writes roll back cleanly.
